rationale: A daily 50/200 moving-average trend strategy with a realized-volatility regime filter was tested because BTCUSDT can trend over multi-week and multi-month horizons, while low-volatility crossover environments can create whipsaw risk. The volatility filter was intended to keep the strategy active only when market conditions were supportive. RETROSPECTIVE: this plan was authored after execution as part of WP-6c to extend the schema grammar to the remaining concluded candidates. The original H-004 pre-registration lives in research/hypotheses/H-004/HYPOTHESIS.md and was not schema-validated at the time.
hypothesis_to_test: A daily 50/200 SMA crossover strategy with a realized-volatility regime filter on BTCUSDT perpetuals will generate OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs, capture both bullish and bearish daily trend regimes when volatility is supportive, reduce low-quality crossover exposure by staying flat in low-volatility regimes, and survive walk-forward validation with efficiency > 0.5.

additional_criteria: OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs
Gate 2 passes under current evaluator semantics: dsr_val > 0.95 versus the expected maximum-SR benchmark from the registered trial count
Max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold
Parameter sensitivity: +/-25% parameter shift keeps Sharpe within 70% of baseline
No single 90-day window contributes > 60% of total PnL
Kill criteria from H-004 HYPOTHESIS.md apply: OOS Sharpe < 0.3, max drawdown > 35%, both long and short legs unprofitable, or volatility filter failing to improve crossover quality

data_requirements: BTCUSDT funding rates full history supplied for funding cashflows: data/processed/binance_um_perp_BTCUSDT_funding_8h_2019-09-10_2026-04-12_2026-04-12T1655Z.parquet
No separate IS/OOS split convention existed in repo truth for this baseline; DEC-0004 records full-period Sharpe in both trial-log Sharpe fields
